translations.web: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
translations.bsb: Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate.
translations.kjv: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
translations.asv: Thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate Behind thy veil.
